subject.title: fix: handle Claude CLI synthetic placeholders

question: Should exact Claude CLI `model: "<synthetic>"` placeholder turns with no visible assistant reply route through existing model fallback as `empty_result`, or should they be handled as status-only/session-preservation behavior?
rationale: The patch is a narrow code fix, but it deliberately changes fallback, provider-routing, and reused-session cleanup semantics for an observed Claude CLI runtime edge case.

options.title: Accept Narrow Fallback Semantics
options.body: Land after rebase if maintainers agree exact known Claude CLI placeholders should become fallback candidates while visible output, hook blocks, incomplete-turn preservation, and explicit silence stay protected.

options.title: Pair With Session Preservation
options.body: Review this together with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99139 so placeholder classification and reused-session cleanup behavior land as one recovery story.

options.title: Pause For Status-Only Direction
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers decide synthetic placeholders should only surface observability/status and must not trigger cross-provider fallback.

recommendation.title: Accept Narrow Fallback Semantics
recommendation.body: Land after rebase if maintainers agree exact known Claude CLI placeholders should become fallback candidates while visible output, hook blocks, incomplete-turn preservation, and explicit silence stay protected.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Claude CLI empty-result work by steipete/totobusnello created the current conflict surface and is closest to the parser/fallback decision.
